facts.fact: Decree no. 2015-79 of 4 February 2015, signed by the President, sets the filing, authorisation, withdrawal and fine-recovery procedures under law no. 2013-450 of 19 June 2013 on personal data protection.

The decree names ARTCI as the body that receives declarations, rules on authorisation requests within one month, and imposes withdrawals and fines under the 2013 law; it shows no appointment of members or acting decisions.

The decree, made under law no. 2013-450 of 19 June 2013 on personal data protection, treats the law as operating, with filing fees, prior authorisations and fines up to FCFA 500 million on repeat breach.
